facts.fact: The Federal Ministry of Health and Social Welfare's architecture document says Nigeria lacks health data standards and a functional health information exchange, that no national health information exchange brings health data together, and that health information stays in the system where it is generated; no date is given for the statement, so the document's publication date is used.
facts.system: Health Information Exchange (HIE) with Shared Health Record

facts.fact: The document says the National Council on Health approved in 2024 the creation and implementation of the Nigeria Digital in Health Initiative, to build a unified, interoperable health data and services infrastructure, with the Nigeria Digital Health Architecture (a federal HIE with shared health record, health claims exchange and health services exchange) as its third pillar and the HIE still to be built and operated by the NDHTO.
facts.system: Nigeria Digital Health Architecture (HIE with Shared Health Record)

systems.system: Health Information Exchange (HIE) with Shared Health Record
systems.owner: Nigeria Digital Health Transformation Organisation (NDHTO), under the Federal Ministry of Health and Social Welfare
systems.tiers: federal HIE plus optional state-level HIEs (multi-HIE architecture)

systems.platform: based on the National Identification Number (NIN)

systems.system: Nigeria Health Logistics Management Information System (NHLMIS)

note: The document is an architecture: it describes planned exchanges, not any in service.
